component.name: Binark
component.summary: Convert text, numbers and files to and from binary

description.p: Binark is a native GNOME application for converting text, integers and files to their binary representation and back.

ul.li: UTF-8 text to and from byte-wise binary notation
Arbitrary-precision conversion between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal
Streaming file encoding and decoding with progress and cancellation
Configurable formatting, optional local history and light/dark themes
